summary.headline: A Full Weekend of Matches Ahead
body: It's a busy few days for the group — Elizabeth is riding high after her first college milestones, Kylie opens conference play at home, and Anna gets two cracks at the same opponent. Several of the girls are also in multi-match road trips, so there's a lot to watch this weekend.
Anna — Morehead State at Marshall Friday 4 PM CT, then hosts Marshall Saturday 1 PM CT, both on ESPN+. A home-and-home gives the Eagles two chances to bounce back after last week's losses.

Elizabeth — UIC plays three straight Valley road matches: Loyola Thursday 6 PM CT, NIU Friday 6 PM CT, DePaul Saturday 5 PM CT, all on ESPN+. She just picked up her first college dig and block assist, so keep an eye on her stat line growing.

Gracyn — Gardner-Webb plays three matches in Clarksville, TN: Austin Peay Friday noon CT, Southern Illinois Friday 3 PM CT, and SIUE Saturday 10 AM CT. The Runnin' Bulldogs have won four of their last six, so momentum is on their side.
Kylie — Arkansas Tech hosts Southern Arkansas Thursday 6 PM CT on GAC Sports Network to open conference play, then travels to Arkansas-Monticello Friday 4 PM CT. The Golden Suns start 1-0 in the GAC.
Layla — Winona State travels to Wayne State Friday 6 PM CT and Augustana Saturday 5 PM CT, both on MidcoSportsPlus. The Warriors are still looking to build momentum in NSIC play.
Mary — Trevecca is on the road at Auburn-Montgomery Friday 5 PM CT and Valdosta State Saturday noon CT, both on FloSports. The Trojans are still chasing their first GSC win.
Peyton — Elgin CC travels to Lewis & Clark Community College Saturday 10 AM CT, her only match this weekend as she keeps working into the libero/DS rotation.

spotlight.name: Elizabeth King
spotlight.note: She picked up her first career dig and block assist during a 2-2 week that included two sweeps.

players.name: Anna Schiltz
players.blurb: Anna and the Eagles had a strong week at the Mercyhurst Invitational, sweeping all three matches (Mercyhurst, Cleveland State, and Siena), before dropping back-to-back home matches to Cincinnati and Michigan State. On the season she's appeared in 8 matches and 26 sets, picking up 15 kills, 10 blocks, and 10 digs — while listed as a middle blocker on the roster, she's actually been playing right side for every match so far, per the family. The team is now 4-5 overall and heads to Huntington, WV on Sep 18 to face Marshall.
players.position_note: Listed MB on the roster; has started at right side every match so far (per family).

players.name: Elizabeth King
players.blurb: Elizabeth and the Flames have been busy the last couple weeks, going 2-2 in matches from Sept. 3-13, including back-to-back sweeps of Central Michigan and Western Michigan to close out their home invitational. On the season she's appeared in 8 matches (18 sets) with 20 kills and 8 block assists, so she's carving out a real role as a freshman outside hitter. Up next, UIC heads out for a road trip to Loyola on Sept. 17 before matches at NIU and DePaul.

players.name: Gracyn Sanders

upcoming.location: Boiling Springs, NC, Paul Porter Arena

players.blurb: We weren't able to pull Gracyn's individual stat line this update because Gardner-Webb's stats page mixes up her row with a teammate's, and the season PDF and box scores we had access to didn't include her specific numbers. The Runnin' Bulldogs have been busy and successful lately, winning four of their last six matches including a five-set comeback over UNCW and a sweep of Alabama State, with tougher road losses at Western Carolina and West Georgia. We'll keep watching for her name to show up correctly in the official stats so we can share exactly how much court time she's getting as the season continues.

players.name: Breanna Hard
players.blurb: Breanna has been getting steady time on the court this season, appearing in all 8 matches and 19 sets for the Redhawks as a setter, racking up 55 assists and 22 digs along the way. The team has had a tough stretch lately, but Breanna keeps contributing in a variety of ways beyond just setting. Up next for Roberts Wesleyan is a home match against Assumption on Sept. 19.

players.name: Kylie Lambert
players.blurb: Kylie continues to run the offense for the Golden Suns, averaging about 4 assists per set (93 assists over 23 sets) along with 7 service aces and 24 digs on the season, so she's clearly getting good court time as the team's setter. The squad had a mixed stretch lately, beating Henderson State 3-1 at home but dropping matches to Pittsburg State and Missouri Western. We don't have details yet on her next scheduled match, but she'll keep working to help the team bounce back.

players.name: Layla Merlin
players.blurb: The Warriors have had a busy stretch, playing in tournaments up in Michigan and out in San Diego before matches against Sioux Falls (Sep 11) and Southwest Minnesota State (Sep 12). Unfortunately, the pages we have don't include a final score or Layla's individual stat line for any of these recent matches, so we can't say yet how much court time she's getting right now. We'll keep checking back as the season moves further into conference play to get a clearer picture of her role.

players.name: Mary Francl
players.hometown_hs: Elk Grove Village, IL / St. Viator HS
players.blurb: The Trojans have had a tough stretch, dropping their last four matches (including three straight on the Florida road trip to Nova Southeastern, Lynn, and Palm Beach Atlantic) to sit at 2-7 overall with conference play still to begin. Mary hasn't recorded any stats yet this season - she isn't listed in the official individual stat tables, which is common for a true freshman still working her way into the rotation behind the team's established outside/right-side hitters. No games to worry over performance-wise yet, but keep an eye on the schedule for when Gulf South Conference matches start, since that's often when coaches start giving newcomers more looks.

players.name: Peyton Strout
players.blurb: The Mavericks had a tough stretch in early September, dropping close five-set battles to Fresno Pacific and Alaska Fairbanks and a straight-set loss to Alaska Anchorage during their Alaska trip, and they also played Wayne State on Sep 11 (final score not available yet). Peyton has appeared in 1 set so far this season, so she's still working her way into regular rotation as a freshman — no stats to report from that appearance yet. We'll keep watching for more playing time as the season continues into conference play.

players.name: Catherine Callahan
players.blurb: The Scots were in action on September 3rd, falling 0-3 on the road at Waubonsee Community College — that was the only completed match we could confirm in the September 2–16 window from public results. Unfortunately, McHenry County College's stats pages were cookie/blocker-protected in our search, so we weren't able to pull Catherine's individual box-score line (kills, digs, etc.) or confirm her playing time for this stretch — we don't want to guess at numbers that aren't clearly hers. We'll keep checking for her next match and box score so we can give you a clearer picture of how much court time she's getting as a freshman libero/DS.

players.name: Madison Mitchell
players.blurb: The team's most recent result we could confirm was a 0-3 road loss at Waubonsee Community College on September 3rd. We weren't able to pull up a detailed box score or Madison's individual stat line from the site this time, so we can't say for certain how much court time she's getting right now, but we'll keep checking. Nothing beyond that date has posted yet, so her next match should be coming up soon — we'll update as soon as new results are available.

players.name: Peyton Wurtz
players.blurb: I wasn't able to pull any Elgin Community College match results or box scores from September 2-16, 2026, or find Peyton's individual stat line in the snippets available to me this time — the team's stats and schedule pages didn't return usable rows for that window. What I can confirm is that Peyton is on the 2026 Spartans roster as a Defensive Specialist/Libero, and the team's next scheduled match is at Lewis & Clark Community College on September 19, 2026. I'd recommend checking the Elgin Spartans site directly or asking the coaching staff for her latest digs and playing time updates since I couldn't verify specifics for this stretch.

players.name: Haidyn Schatz
players.blurb: Haidyn is a student at Clemson and has stepped away from volleyball. Go Tigers.
